title: Bohlale Mphahlele: Inventor of Alerting Earpiece on helping save women's lives
summary: A woman who came to the world's attention at the age of just 16 has spoken to FRANCE 24 about how helping women has been an honour for her. Now 22, as a teenager Bohlale Mphahlele invented what she calls the Alerting Earpiece, designed to help protect women against sexual predators.
